notes.title: New Demo Version!
notes.notes:
Demo Update!

Hi everybody, we uploaded a new version of the demo that contains an active GatherBot! (It should update automatically in your library)
The bot comes with 2 personalities ; happy or moody (random at start). 


His job is set to cleaning the dust. At this point, in the demo there is no way to overwrite it. In the full game, GatherBots come with multiple function/jobs that can be activated/switched at any time or on schedule.  

You can either call it as before (Right Vive Controller Grip) or just use your voice! Calling  “GatherBot” will make him come to you. (And there are some extra voice command there, find them out!)

Please setup your microphone before to try it out. (Either external microphone or the Vive built-in) and make sure it is set by default in windows settings. 


Here are some bind keys that might help :


Y : Switch GatherBot pesonality. (Happy/Moody)
R : Turn On/Off Super-sampling (Be aware 1080 recommended). 
E : Restart the demo. 


Let us know what you think!


Thanks!


Suspended Reality.
